_how_to: Who may see and do what in TRUST (docs/wiki/roles-and-permissions.md). Edit, save, deploy.

user_header: the name of the request header in which the access add-on passes each person's SAM_ACCOUNT. While it is empty, TRUST runs open: anyone past the add-on can do everything and types their name, and the page says so.
groups_header: the header with the person's AD groups (names or CN=... distinguished names). groups_separator: what separates them (a comma unless set).
groups: the AD groups for each role. A person in several groups gets every matching role. Group names are matched without regard to capitals.
family_lead_groups: optional AD groups per product family id, for delegates; owners in the product family owners file are family leads already.
Family members need no group: TRUST places them through HR and the owners file, like their work.
WARNING: once user_header is set, anyone not in one of these groups, and not placed in a family, is turned away. To undo, empty user_header and deploy.
